title: What a Burrow Can Teach Builders
paras: On a disused railway line, an old passenger [[carriage|carriage]] has become an unusual laboratory. Inside, researcher Amara Sen studies how a rabbit's [[burrow|burrow]] stays cool beneath sun-baked ground. Her team hopes that understanding this natural shelter could improve buildings without disturbing the grassland [[ecosystem|ecosystem]] outside. Rather than opening occupied tunnels, they build artificial ones beside the laboratory.

Each model has a different roof [[thickness|thickness]], ranging from ten to fifty centimetres of soil. Sensors record temperatures above and below ground, while a [[protective|protective]] cover keeps rain away from the electrical equipment. On a computer screen, [[vivid|vivid]] orange and purple bands reveal the contrast between hot surfaces and cooler spaces underneath. The team also measures moisture, since wet soil transfers heat differently from dry soil.

During an early trial, one shallow tunnel appeared cooler than every deeper model. The result seemed to support a supplier's claim that its special soil mixture provided exceptional insulation. However, Sen would not [[declare|declare]] the product effective on the strength of one reading. Nor would an unsuccessful test alone prove [[fraud|fraud]]: deliberate deception and poor performance are not the same thing.

Repeated measurements eventually exposed a [[faulty|faulty]] sensor. Once it was replaced, the [[data|data]] showed a more ordinary pattern: deeper soil reduced daytime temperature swings. The finding was less dramatic than the original result, but more useful. For builders seeking reliable ways to limit summer heat, a carefully measured rabbit shelter may offer better guidance than an exciting sales claim.
zh: 在一条废弃的铁路线上，一节旧客车厢变成了一间不同寻常的实验室。研究员阿玛拉·森在里面研究兔子的地洞如何在被太阳晒热的地面下保持凉爽。她的团队希望，通过了解这种天然庇护所，在不干扰外面草地生态系统的前提下改进建筑。他们没有挖开仍有动物居住的地道，而是在实验室旁建造人工地道。
每个模型上方的覆土厚度各不相同，从十厘米到五十厘米不等。传感器记录地上和地下的温度，防护罩则让电气设备免受雨淋。电脑屏幕上，鲜艳的橙色和紫色条带显示出炎热地表与下方凉爽空间的温差。团队还测量土壤湿度，因为湿土与干土的传热方式不同。
在早期的一次试验中，一条较浅地道的温度似乎比所有更深的模型都低。这个结果看起来支持了某家供应商的说法：其特殊土壤混合物具有出色的隔热性能。然而，森不会仅凭一次读数就宣布该产品有效。同样，一次失败的测试本身也不足以证明存在欺诈：蓄意欺骗和性能不佳并不是一回事。
反复测量最终发现，一个传感器出了故障。更换之后，数据显示出一种更常见的规律：更深的覆土能减小白天的温度波动。这一发现没有最初的结果那么引人注目，却更加实用。对于寻找可靠方法来缓解夏季炎热的建筑师而言，对兔子地洞的细致测量，或许比令人心动的销售宣传更有指导价值。

q.s: The team spent a month building the artificial tunnels.
q.why: 文章未说明建造人工地道用了多久。

q.s: Sen accepted a single temperature measurement as sufficient evidence of the product's effectiveness.
q.why: 森不愿仅凭一次读数宣布产品有效。

q.s: After the sensor was replaced, the measurements showed smaller daytime temperature swings beneath deeper soil.
q.why: 更换传感器后，数据显示覆土更深时日间温度波动更小。
